clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, a strongbox of Horde silver has gone missing from the guard tower. Sunscale raptors carried the coins to their nests at the Raptor Grounds south of Ratchet.

Sunscale raptors carried a strongbox of silver from the Crossroads guard tower. The coins were meant as pay for the garrison guards. The raptors dragged the lockbox to their communal nests at the Raptor Grounds, south of Ratchet. Gazrog and the other overseers cannot explain why the predators took it. The theft leaves them wondering whether the raptors prize shiny things or possess a cunning beyond that of ordinary wild beasts.
